# mcp-db通用

数据库无关 **MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器** 它允许您通过Claude或GitHub Copilot与数据库聊天。用简单的英语提问，AI将为您编写和执行SQL。

## 支持的数据库

|数据库|驱动程序|安装|
|------------|------------------|----------------------------|
|PostgreSQL| `pg` | `npm install pg` |
|MySQL| `mysql2` | `npm install mysql2` |
|SQL Server| `mssql` | `npm install mssql` |
|SQLite| `better-sqlite3` | `npm install better-sqlite3` |
|Oracle| `oracledb` | `npm install oracledb` |

______________________________________________________________________

## 快速开始

### 0.先决条件——安装Node.js

此工具运行于 **Node.js**。如果您没有安装它，请先安装：

1. 首选 **[nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org)** 并下载 **长期支持** 版本（推荐给大多数用户）
1. 运行安装程序并按照提示操作
1. 安装后，打开终端（Windows上的命令提示符/PowerShell，macOS/Linux上的终端）并验证其是否正常工作：

```bash
node --version   # should print something like v20.x.x
npm --version    # should print something like 10.x.x
```

如果两个命令都返回版本号，则可以继续

### 1.全局安装

```bash
npm install -g fm-db-mcp-universal

# Then install your DB driver:
npm install -g pg           # PostgreSQL
npm install -g mysql2       # MySQL
npm install -g mssql tedious # SQL Server
npm install -g better-sqlite3  # SQLite
npm install -g oracledb     # Oracle
```

### 2.连接到克劳德桌面

编辑 `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json` （macOS）或 `C:\Users\\AppData\Roaming\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json` （Windows）：

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "my-db": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["fm-db-mcp-universal"],
      "env": {
        "DB_CLIENT":   "oracle",
        "DB_HOST":     "localhost",
        "DB_PORT":     "1521",
        "DB_NAME":     "orcl",
        "DB_USER":     "xxx",
        "DB_PASSWORD": "xxx"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

### 3.连接VS Code（GitHub复制代理模式）

创建 `.vscode/mcp.json` 在您的工作空间中：

```json
{
  "servers": {
    "oracle-db": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "fm-db-mcp-universal"
      ],
      "env": {
        "DB_CLIENT": "oracle",
        "DB_HOST": "localhost",
        "DB_PORT": "1521",
        "DB_NAME": "orcl",
        "DB_USER": "FMCPROD1",
        "DB_PASSWORD": "FMCPROD1"
      }
    },
    "postgres-db": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "fm-db-mcp-universal"
      ],
      "env": {
        "DB_CLIENT": "postgres",
        "DB_HOST": "localhost",
        "DB_PORT": "5432",
        "DB_USER": "postgres",
        "DB_PASSWORD": "password",
        "DB_NAME": "postgres"
      }
    },
    "mssql-db": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "fm-db-mcp-universal"
      ],
      "env": {
        "DB_CLIENT": "mssql",
        "DB_HOST": "localhost",
        "DB_PORT": "1433",
        "DB_USER": "sa",
        "DB_PASSWORD": "sadmin",
        "DB_NAME": "ALLMERGE"
      }
    },
  }
}
```

______________________________________________________________________

## 配置

所有配置都是通过环境变量进行的：

|变量|描述|默认值|
|-----------------------|--------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| `DB_CLIENT` |数据库类型： `postgres`, `mysql`, `mssql`, `sqlite`, `oracle` | `postgres` |
| `DB_HOST` |数据库主机| `localhost` |
| `DB_PORT` |数据库端口（如果未设置，则自动检测）|每个数据库|
| `DB_USER` |用户名|--|
| `DB_PASSWORD` |密码|--|
| `DB_NAME` |数据库名称|--|
| `DB_FILENAME` |文件路径（仅限SQLite）|--|
| `DB_CONNECTION_STRING`|完整连接字符串（覆盖上述内容）|--|
| `DB_READONLY` |设置 `true` 禁用写入/DDL| `false` |
| `DB_POOL_MIN` |连接池最小值| `1` |
| `DB_POOL_MAX` |连接池最大值| `5` |

### 使用连接字符串

```json
{
  "env": {
    "DB_CLIENT": "postgres",
    "DB_CONNECTION_STRING": "postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/mydb"
  }
}
```

______________________________________________________________________

## 数据库特定示例

### PostgreSQL

```json
{
  "DB_CLIENT": "postgres",
  "DB_HOST": "localhost",
  "DB_USER": "postgres",
  "DB_PASSWORD": "secret",
  "DB_NAME": "myapp"
}
```

### MySQL/MariaDB

```json
{
  "DB_CLIENT": "mysql",
  "DB_HOST": "localhost",
  "DB_USER": "root",
  "DB_PASSWORD": "secret",
  "DB_NAME": "myapp"
}
```

### SQL Server（MSSQL）

```json
{
  "DB_CLIENT": "mssql",
  "DB_HOST": "localhost",
  "DB_PORT": "1433",
  "DB_USER": "sa",
  "DB_PASSWORD": "YourPassword123!",
  "DB_NAME": "Northwind"
}
```

### SQLite

```json
{
  "DB_CLIENT": "sqlite",
  "DB_FILENAME": "/path/to/database.db"
}
```

### 甲骨文

```json
{
  "DB_CLIENT": "oracle",
  "DB_HOST": "localhost",
  "DB_PORT": "1521",
  "DB_USER": "myuser",
  "DB_PASSWORD": "mypassword",
  "DB_NAME": "ORCL"
}
```

## 可用的MCP工具

|工具|说明|
|----------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| `db_ping` |测试连接并确认其正常工作|
| `db_query` |运行SELECT查询（只读，自动限制为100行）|
| `db_execute` |运行INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL（在只读模式下禁用）|
| `db_list_tables` |列出所有表和视图|
| `db_describe_table` |获取表的列、类型和可空性|
| `db_table_indexes` |获取表的索引信息|
| `db_foreign_keys` |获取表的外键关系|
| `db_schema_snapshot` |一次完整转储所有表的架构|

______________________________________________________________________

## 聊天互动示例

一旦连接，就自然地说话：

> **“我有什么桌子？”**
> → Calls `db_list_tables`

> **“显示过去30天内注册的所有用户”**
> → 写入并执行带有日期筛选器的SELECT

> **“有多少订单处于‘待处理’状态？”**
> → COUNT查询

> **“订单表的模式是什么？”**
> → Calls `db_describe_table`

> **“为users.email添加索引”**
> → Calls `db_execute` 使用CREATE INDEX语句

> **“给我一份今年按地区划分的销售额摘要”**
> → 带聚合的GROUP BY查询

______________________________________________________________________

## 只读模式

要保护生产数据库，请启用只读模式：

```json
{
  "env": {
    "DB_READONLY": "true",
    ...
  }
}
```

在只读模式下， `db_execute` 已禁用--只允许SELECT查询。

______________________________________________________________________

## 从源头运行

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourname/mcp-db-universal
cd mcp-db-universal
npm install
npm install better-sqlite3  # or your DB driver
npm run build
```

然后配置Claude/Copilot以使用：

```json
{
  "command": "node",
  "args": ["/path/to/mcp-db-universal/dist/index.js"],
  "env": { ... }
}
```

或者直接在开发模式下运行：

```bash
DB_CLIENT=sqlite DB_FILENAME=./test.db npm run dev
```

______________________________________________________________________

## 发布到npm

```bash
npm run build
npm publish
```

然后用户可以使用 `npx`:

```json
{
  "command": "npx",
  "args": ["mcp-db-universal"],
  "env": { ... }
}
```
